weekly_theme.summary: 水星目前正在逆行（落在天蠍座，10/24–11/13），這段時間適合放慢腳步、重新確認訊息，避免倉促簽約或做重大決定。 太陽剛進入天蠍座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天蠍座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，終於感覺時鐘在你這邊了。無需處理緊急任務、緊急回電或在附近徘徊的任何人，您終於可以輕鬆呼吸了。這種新發現的自由可以讓您更有效地專注於手頭的任務。夜幕降臨，您可以在舒適的家中放鬆身心，享用外賣美食，並欣賞精彩電影。
aries.horoscope_en: At last, Aries, it feels like the clock is on your side. With no pressing tasks to tackle, urgent calls to return, or anyone hovering nearby, you can finally breathe easy. This newfound freedom allows you to concentrate more effectively on the tasks at hand. As the evening rolls in, unwind in the comfort of your home, treat yourself to some takeout, and enjoy a good film.

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座，你的浪漫關係感覺特別牢固。當你回顧這段旅程時，這種安全感籠罩著你，就像一個溫暖的擁抱，帶領你走向這一新發現的承諾。你和你的伴侶可能會在今晚享受彼此的陪伴中找到快樂，這真是太棒了！在你的心中記下這一天，這樣當懷疑開始蔓延時，你就可以重新審視它。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, your romantic relationship feels particularly solid. The sense of security envelops you like a warm embrace as you reflect on the journey that has brought you to this newfound commitment. You and your partner might find joy in simply enjoying each other's company this evening, and that’s perfectly wonderful! Make a note of this day in your heart, so you can revisit it whenever doubts start to creep in.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，今天你可能會發現自己缺乏工作動力，可能會想逃避職責。如果您的日程表上沒有緊迫的任務，為什麼不接受這種休息的渴望呢？用一本迷人的書和一杯溫暖的茶來犒賞自己，享受一個舒適的下午。欣賞心愛的電影，或在風景如畫的公園中悠閒漫步。隨著傍晚臨近，與伴侶依偎在一起，享受當天的舒緩氛圍。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you might find yourself lacking motivation for work and could be tempted to skip out on your duties. If there are no pressing tasks on your agenda, why not embrace this desire for a break? Treat yourself to a cozy afternoon with a captivating book and a warm cup of tea. Enjoy a beloved film or take a leisurely stroll through a picturesque park. As the evening approaches, snuggle up with a partner and relish the soothing vibes of the day.

cancer.horoscope_en: Today, you might find yourself facing a community matter involving your neighbors, Cancer. There’s a chance a meeting will take place to discuss it. A change is needed in your area, and it seems that many of you are likely on the same page about it. This collective effort is promising for what lies ahead, and you’ll likely leave the gathering feeling positive about the outcome. Keep moving forward!

leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you might encounter a fresh opportunity on your path. While there's no certainty attached, the stars suggest that if you commit wholeheartedly, your prospects for advancement in any endeavor you start today are quite favorable over the coming month. Stay diligent and maintain that bright smile of yours! Remember, your positivity is just as crucial as your hard work.

virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, if you've been eyeing a specific online course or workshop, today is an excellent opportunity to dive into the details. Take some time to make inquiries or even sign up. Your concentration on educational pursuits is strong right now, and you're likely to commit fully to any program you choose. Expect to absorb information swiftly and remember it well. So, ponder your options, explore the relevant materials, and reach out to gather more information!

libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, it's time to turn your attention to financial decisions, whether they involve investments, savings, or other monetary concerns. Stay calm; you're in a great mindset for this. Your business acumen is sharper than ever, and your concentration is spot on. Trust your instincts—they're guiding you well. Even if you're not in the mood, tackling these tasks is crucial, as your focus may wane tomorrow.

scorpio.horoscope_en: If you and a friend have been contemplating a business venture, Scorpio, now is the perfect time to dive into some in-depth conversations about the specifics of your collaboration. Consider the business model, its structure, and the financial aspects involved. With your keen insights, you can recognize both the potential rewards and the risks of this endeavor. Grab some paper and pens, and start mapping out your ideas!

On the relationship front, things are also looking positive. Seize this opportunity while it lasts!
